description: Use this when you want data from another paid API without handling its invoice: pay ONE BitTuitive invoice (sats, or the same all-in price in USDC via x402) and BitTuitive pays the upstream, calls it and returns its JSON in `data` plus `routing` (upstream, score, fee). Pass capability and optional prefer (recommended), or endpoint_id / data_type / q (legacy). Never returns the upstream URL. For capability=ai_inference POST a prompt or messages (optional model, max_tokens). For capability=web_search pass query (or q). fallback. Cost: upstream price + routing fee max(20%, 3 sats). Side effect: spends your payment on the upstream call; if every upstream fails you get a 24h credit token to pass as `credit`. If the result is status 'running', repeat the identical call to collect it. Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Example: call_routed_api(capability="web_search", query="bitcoin") Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

capability.description: Data point id from list_route_capabilities (including ai_inference and web_search).

credit.description: 24h credit token from an earlier failed routed call (instead of paying).

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

messages.description: ai_inference: chat messages with role and content.

model.description: ai_inference: optional open-weight model id. Omit for the default.

params.description: Optional query parameters forwarded to the upstream API.

prompt.description: ai_inference: a single user prompt (or pass messages).

q.description: Best-pick keywords, or a web_search query.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].

name: call_routed_api
title: BitTuitive Tools (AI inference, web search) and Router calls (sats or USDC)
